messages:
Marco (AE): Quick ask — FirstCity Bank POC requesting a compliance package before we can spin up their dedicated instance. They specifically asked for SOC 2 artifacts + a signed penetration-test attestation. Can we assemble a redacted bundle and a pen-test letter? They want an ETA by EOD Friday so they can kick off procurement.

Aditi (Security): We have a standard SOC2 bundle we can reuse. Clarify whether they need the full Type II report or a redacted summary + control mapping. For pentest attestation we have a signed template from our vendor that omits vuln details. ETA ~= 3 business days to assemble and review. If they insist on full report we need legal approval.

Samir (SE): Important: if this is for a Private/On-Prem POC, they also asked about KMS/key handling docs and the deployment timeline (they mentioned 2 weeks). Also pricing question — do we waive the first month for POC or provide a credit? That often helps unblock procurement.

Lina (ComplianceOps): I can build the evidence package. Typical contents we send:
```
- SOC2: Independent Auditor's Opinion (redacted), System Description, Control Matrix mapping to customer questions
- Bridge Letter (if controls period doesn't align)
- Pen Test: Vendor attestation letter (signed), summary of findings (high-level, redacted)
- KMS: Key handling summary + rotation policy excerpt + architecture diagram
- Data Flow diagram for Private deploy
```
We will redact IP and internal endpoints. Need customer full legal name + contact and the PoC SOW (if any). Also confirm if they need any encryption algorithms or FIPS statements explicitly.

Aaron (Legal): If we're sharing pen-test artifacts, we need to ensure vendor NDA + our contract permits disclosure. Use our standard "PenTest Attestation" template — include the sentence: "No unresolved critical findings exist as of the attestation date." I'll review any redactions to ensure they don't create contractual false statements. CC me on the final package.

Marco (AE): @Lina I'll DM the FirstCity contact and the PoC SOW. They specifically asked about KMS: want confirmation of customer-managed keys vs Redwood-managed for Private. Also asked whether SOC2 is relevant for regional regulatory reviewers (EU).

Aditi (Security): For Private we support customer-provided KMS (via BYOK/HSM) — provide architecture + KMS onboarding checklist. For SOC2, our report covers common cloud controls; for EU regulators we can provide the mapping to GDPR-related controls in the control matrix.

ComplianceBot: Created ticket C-2026-345: "FirstCity POC evidence bundle" assigned to Lina (ComplianceOps). Due date set to 3 business days.

Lina (ComplianceOps): Noted. I'll assemble the drafts and send them for security/legal review before redaction. Quick checklist for Marco: customer legal name, email for delivery, any required PO numbers, and whether they want the pen-test attestation notarized/scanned.

Samir (SE): Regarding pricing: I propose a POC credit (one month) and an expedited Private deploy fee waiver for the first 2 weeks. Finance needs to approve but I can push and confirm by EOD.

Marco (AE): Great — thanks everyone. Lina I will DM the contact now. @Aaron ping me if the pen-test template needs wording tweaks. Samir let me know about the pricing credit once finance responds.

Samir (SE): :thumbsup: will update by EOD.
